scope: One existing generic illustrative fish (fish_03), not species identification or full anatomy/reef validation.

references.credit: George Ryschkewitsch, via Florida Museum of Natural History
references.observed: Continuous pigmentation following the body surface; slender fin membranes with directional supporting rays. Photo is a named real fish, not evidence of the generic model identity.
references.use: Privately viewed as reference; no photo pixels copied into shaders, textures or public artifacts.

references.credit: Florida Museum of Natural History anatomy teaching diagram
references.observed: Distinction between spines and simple/branched fin rays. Supports general structure vocabulary, not fin counts or a calibrated species reconstruction.
references.use: Viewed only; not copied into the model or public files.

non_evidence: The distant NOAA-courtesy reef photo Abudefduf-saxatilis-04.jpg was viewed but is too coarse for detailed fin anatomy.
implementation_intent: Retain existing pigment phase and subdued palette, evaluate a continuous local-coordinate pigment field and closed thinner fins. Keep fish_05 and all other fish unchanged; apply only after companion cloning.
boundaries: No claims of identified species, observed co-occurrence, actual density, measured size or photoreal completion.
Underlying generic body shape, routes and animation interfaces remain unchanged.
Actual same-phase browser comparisons are required; offline specimen preview is not runtime proof.
